name: hoc/data-list
description: A high-level list HOC that maps column definitions into list slots and orchestrates request-driven data loading, search, pagination, row selection, and expandable rows. Composed from List primitives and utility controls with i18n support through ConfigProvider.
useCases: Project and product feeds that need async loading plus list-first presentation
Issue and ticket lists combining slot-based rendering with searchable metadata
Mobile-friendly data views where list layout is preferred over table grids
Operational task boards with row selection and inline expanded details
usage: import { DataList, type DataListProps, type DataListColumn } from "shadcn-solid-components/hoc/data-list"
